# Numora

> Numora is a set of free money calculators localized for 26 countries in 12 languages, plus Numi, a rules-based assistant that answers money questions in plain words in the visitor's language. Everything runs in the browser; no personal data is collected.

## Calculators
- [Mortgage / home loan payoff](./#mortgage): extra payments, lump sums, goal solver. Applies Canadian semi-annual compounding.
- [Debt payoff planner](./#debt): snowball vs avalanche with a debt-free date.
- [Loan repayment / EMI](./#emi)
- [Credit card payoff](./#card)
- [Rent vs buy](./#rentbuy)
- [SIP / monthly investing](./#sip), with yearly step-up
- [Compound interest](./#compound)
- [Savings goal](./#goal)
- [Fixed deposit / CD / GIC / term deposit](./#fd)
- [Retirement & FIRE](./#fire)
- [Inflation](./#inflation)

## Assistant
- [Ask Numi](./?ask=hi): type or speak a question such as "EMI on 10 lakh at 10.5% for 5 years"; Numi runs the matching calculator and explains the result.

## Methodology
- Loan payment: P × r ÷ (1 − (1 + r)^−n), r = monthly rate, n = months.
- SIP: contributions at the start of each month, compounded monthly at the yearly rate ÷ 12.
- FIRE target: yearly spending ÷ safe withdrawal rate (default 4%), modelled in today's money.
